info.title: Ollama Optivus AI API
info.description:
Video analysis with speech-to-text, OCR, object detection and scene understanding, summarized by a local Ollama model into JSON.

**Typical flow:** `POST /v1/videos` (upload) -> `POST /v1/jobs` (start) -> `GET /v1/jobs/{id}?wait=30` (poll) -> read `payload.job.result`.

All endpoints except `/`, `/health/*` and these docs require `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
The legacy endpoints `/upload`, `/videos`, `/delete` and `/process` are deprecated but fully supported.

root.description: Name of a storage root from PROCESSING_ROOTS, e.g. "videos" or "nas".

path.description: Path of the video relative to that root.

language.description: Speech/on-screen text language (ISO 639-1) or "auto" to detect it.

videoExplanation.description: Context for the model, e.g. "A recorded support call between an agent and a customer".

model.description: Ollama model for the summary (must be in OLLAMA_AI_ALLOWED_MODELS).

format.description: "json" for free-form JSON, or a JSON schema the answer must follow (Ollama structured outputs). Defaults to { summary, events }.

noPrompting.description: Only analyze the video and build the prompt; skip the language model.

features.description: Analysis features. Defaults to PROCESSING_FEATURES (plus "captions" when vision is enabled).

sampleFps.description: Frames analyzed per second of video.
